label: prop:alpha-cluster-activation-gate
title: The $\alpha$-cluster activation gate: Milnor indeterminacy, sign-rep obstruction, and $\mathrm{Vol}=0$ annihilation
html:
Proposition (\alpha-cluster activation gate). Let a three-cluster arrangement carry pairwise linking numbers (\ell_{12},\ell_{13},\ell_{23})\in\mathbb{Z}^3, and let \Delta = \gcd(\ell_{12},\ell_{13},\ell_{23}). The Milnor triple-linking residue \bar\mu is a well-defined invariant only in \mathbb{Z}/\Delta\mathbb{Z} [milnor1954]. Then:

  1. (Hopf-spectator gate closed) if some pairwise linking is a unit |\ell_{ij}| = 1, then \Delta = 1, so \mathbb{Z}/\Delta\mathbb{Z} is a subsingleton and \bar\mu carries no invariant triple content — the bond channel is inactive;
  2. (Brunnian gate open) the residue space is the full \mathbb{Z} (the gate is open, \Delta = 0) iff all pairwise linkings vanish, \ell_{12}=\ell_{13}=\ell_{23}=0 — the Brunnian/Borromean pattern;
  3. (sign-representation obstruction) any \Sigma_3-equivariant linear map from the pair-vector module to the sign representation is identically zero over any commutative ring; the inter-cluster coupling therefore factors through |\bar\mu| only (no chirality-odd channel);
  4. (\mathrm{Vol}=0 annihilation) the W-plane binding term \mathfrak{m}_e\,\mathrm{Vol}\,q on a bond channel of hyperbolic volume \mathrm{Vol}=0 is identically zero.

Together (1)–(4) are a topological selection rule: a three-cluster bond channel contributes body-order binding content only when its arrangement is Brunnian (2) and its sub-link has \mathrm{Vol}\neq 0 (4), and any surviving coupling is chirality-even (3). Hopf-linked spectator pairs (1) are switched off. This is the categorical origin of the "k\ge 3, \alpha-only" activation pattern: two \alpha-clusters share a Hopf-type spectator link (gate closed), whereas a Borromean triple of \alpha-clusters opens the gate.

Lean structure

All four parts are formalized sorry-free (generic commutative ring where the statement permits):

  • (1)–(2) QOU.Mass.MilnorIndeterminacyGate — gate_kills_hopf_spectator (|\ell_{ij}|=1 \Rightarrow \mathrm{Subsingleton}\,(\mathbb{Z}/\Delta\mathbb{Z})) and gate_open_iff_brunnian (\Delta = 0 \iff all \ell_{ij}=0), with the structure-level ClusterTriple.residue_nontrivial_of_brunnian.
  • (3) QOU.Mass.MilnorSignRepObstruction.equivariant_linearMap_eq_zero (Schur-lemma vanishing of the \Sigma_3 sign-rep coupling over any CommRing), with coupling_vanishes_on_charge_bilinears.
  • (4) QOU.Mass.BondChannelClassSelection.wplane_term_eq_zero_of_vol_eq_zero (\mathrm{Vol}=0 \Rightarrow \mathfrak{m}_e\,\mathrm{Vol}\,q = 0). The companion CAL-3 class-selection statement (eq_cal3_of_support_ne_zero_of_ledger) is a conditional result on the BindingVolumeLedger class (no instance declared — the ledger is an open input, not part of this proposition's proved content).

Scope. Only the topological activation gate — which inter-cluster bond channels are on or off, and the chirality-even coupling — is asserted here. The binding magnitudes B(\text{cluster}), the light-spectator coefficient b, the gated pair coefficient g, and the resulting \le 0.31\% multi-isotope closure ("Model G") are not part of this proposition. Those enter the cluster bindings at their measured AME values and calibrate b, g empirically; they are recorded — labelled as a structural/phenomenological model, not a parameter-free derivation — in the interpreting remark rem:alpha-cluster-model-g-closure.
